meta.tb2_def: mean(top-2 hourly LMP) - mean(bottom-2 hourly LMP) per flowday; hourly period-ending CT (HE1..HE24)
meta.revenue_proxy: TB2 x 200 MWh (100MW/2h), before round-trip efficiency; no RTE applied

forecast.method: trend-extrapolated TB index (2h) x Houston 2h peer capture rate
caveats: Peer capture is Jan1-May25 2026 (winter+spring) - summer peer disclosure was not downloaded (run stopped by user). Summer capture may differ.
TB index assumes 2 MWh/MW/day and no round-trip-efficiency haircut; peer opt_rate is measured on the same basis, so the ratio is internally consistent.
The 2027 decline factor (0.90) is the single largest driver - see tb_index_sensitivity.
Proxy validated on ~100 summer days only; winter/shoulder untested (+-$2-3 TB2).
WHARTN constraint contributes to proxy history but Raven's exposure is unverifiable (item2).
New ERCOT storage additions, AS price decay and RTC+B effects are only implicitly in the trend.
DART virtual excluded - item3a found no node-specific edge at RVN_RN.

proxy.formula: proxy_LMP = intercept + sum(w_i * LMP_i), same weights applied to DA and to RT
proxy.fit_window: 2026-06-04..2026-09-13 (refit on full overlap after OOS selection)
proxy.selected_by: min over OOS(Aug1-Sep13; fit Jun4-Jul31) of mean(TB2_DA_MAE,TB2_RT_MAE)+daily_spread_MAE

fallback.applies_to: flowdays before 2023-12-01 (RBN_BESS1 has no prices before 2023-12)
fallback.note: TAV_RN = best full-history single node by OOS score (1.08 vs winner 0.94); use alone for 2023-09..2023-11

proxy.eligibility_rule: blend members restricted to nodes with DA prices already in 2023-09 (full 3-yr history); WAL_RN (best raw match, online 2025-05) excluded for that reason
limitations: overlap window is ~100 summer days (2026-06-04..09-13); proxy untested in winter/shoulder
RVN_RN online only since 2026-06; its own congestion footprint may still be settling

caveat_wharton.issue: Constraint WHARTN (station-level, base-case, HOUSTON) has shift factor ~1.0 at CBEC_ALL/TAV_RN/SBE_RN_1/DAG_ALL and ~0 at RBN_BESS1/WGU_RN/WAL_RN/WES_ALL/NCO_RN. It last bound 2026-06-02, i.e. never while RVN_RN was priced, so RVN_RN's own SF to it is unobservable and the Jun-Sep 2026 price fit could not learn to exclude it.
caveat_wharton.effect_on_proxy: the chosen blend carries 0.4148+0.0445 = 0.459 x WHARTN lambda into reconstructed RVN prices: cumulative -16,388 $/MWh-h per MW over 2023-09..2026-06 (DA -4,537 / RT -11,852), concentrated Feb-May and Sep-Nov, HE12-17; per-year DA/RT: 2023 -549/-2648, 2024 -2290/-4836, 2025 -1079/-2286, 2026 -619/-2081. If Raven is NOT behind WHARTN, proxy history has spurious midday dips of ~0.46 x lambda (mean lambda DA $7, RT $39; RT p90 $70, max $5,251) on those days, overstating reconstructed TB2 on those days.
caveat_wharton.forward_relevance: low regardless: WHARTN limit raised 470 -> 536 -> 691 MW (2023->2026) and no binding since 2026-06-02.
caveat_wharton.note: WHARTN-free full-history blends score materially worse OOS (1.84-3.72 vs 0.94), so the nominated NNLS blend is kept; strip WHARTN using derived/item2_congestion_hourly_panel.parquet (CONSTRAINTNAME=='WHARTN', mcc_h) if Raven is confirmed not to be behind it.

dart_meta.convention: spread = DA - RT; short PnL = +spread, long PnL = -spread; $/MWh; HE 1..24 period-ending America/Chicago
dart_meta.system_reference: HB_BUSAVG (ERCOT bus-average hub) as congestion-free system price proxy; HB_HOUSTON = Raven zonal hub
dart_meta.tradeable_rule: |t| >= 1.5 and EV>0 and Kelly f>0 and loss_p99 <= 20.0x EV
dart_meta.data: real Yes Energy datalake prices via raw/price_panel (no mock)
